Furthermore, due to a scheduling conflict, the route must incorporate exactly one of the following two critical segments: the connection between Beta and Gamma, or the connection between Gamma and Delta.

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient circuit that services each facility precisely once before concluding back at the point of origin.
